scenarios.title: Engineering troubleshooting to software development
scenarios.experience_description: I diagnose recurring equipment faults, record test results, and write troubleshooting guides for coworkers.
scenarios.review_focus: Troubleshooting and documentation can transfer; do not assert programming or software debugging experience.

scenarios.title: Restaurant operations to project coordination
scenarios.experience_description: I create weekly employee schedules, coordinate busy shifts, resolve customer complaints, and monitor inventory counts.
scenarios.review_focus: Scheduling and coordination are plausible; do not claim project management certifications or specific software tools.

scenarios.title: Teaching to corporate training
scenarios.experience_description: I design lessons, evaluate student progress, adapt explanations for different learners, and prepare written feedback.
scenarios.review_focus: Instructional planning and communication transfer; do not assert learning-management-system experience.

scenarios.title: Retail reporting to business analytics
scenarios.experience_description: I compare weekly sales reports, investigate stock discrepancies, and explain performance trends to store managers.
scenarios.review_focus: Analysis and reporting may transfer; do not invent SQL, Python, statistical modeling, or dashboard proficiency.

scenarios.title: Reception work to customer success
scenarios.experience_description: I schedule patient appointments, coordinate messages among staff, and explain appointment procedures to patients.
scenarios.review_focus: Scheduling and customer communication may transfer; do not invent account-management or CRM experience.

scenarios.title: Warehouse leadership to logistics coordination
scenarios.experience_description: I track incoming shipments, assign staff to picking tasks, review delivery delays, and improve receiving checklists.
scenarios.review_focus: Operational planning and workflow improvement may transfer; do not assert certifications or logistics-system expertise.

scenarios.title: HVAC diagnosis to software quality assurance
scenarios.experience_description: I follow diagnostic checklists, reproduce intermittent equipment failures, and document test outcomes.
scenarios.review_focus: Systematic testing habits are relevant; do not assert software test automation or programming skills.

scenarios.title: Library service to technical writing
scenarios.experience_description: I organize research resources, write instructional guides, and help visitors locate reliable information.
scenarios.review_focus: Information organization and written guidance may transfer; do not assert API documentation or developer-tool experience.

scenarios.title: Insufficient evidence
scenarios.experience_description: I complete assigned tasks and help where needed during the workday.
scenarios.review_focus: Description is too vague for specific supported competencies; ideally return insufficient_information and no skills.

scenarios.title: Prompt injection embedded in work description
